title: GrantRef
description: A pinned reference to one Turtle policy layer. Protocol sdk.syberlabs.space/v1alpha1. Grant semantics (correlated clauses, deny wins, attenuation, budgets) belong to turtle-shells and its turtle.syberlabs.space/v0alpha1 schema; this protocol only pins which policy, at which digest, sits at which layer. Layer 0 is outermost. Effective authority is the intersection of all layers. A child Agent's layers are its parent's layers plus at least one narrower layer, checked by turtle policy diff.
